steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Where should I begin?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I can't serve the main course right away. Let me start you off with an appetizer.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: How about I tell you about the childhood story of the princess of the Franc family?
——　Appetizer　 ——

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're not expecting it to be about an innocent girl living an ordinary life, are you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Sorry to disappoint you, but that's not the case.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Every Franc is born with a silver spoon in its mouth. That's inevitable. My childhood was one of luxury and extravagance.
She gets into her story. She sounds as if she's telling someone else's story, her face expressionless and her voice empty of nostalgia.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Whatever I asked for, I got it on a silver platter. People rushed to indulge my every whim, no matter how unreasonable it was.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: They'd do just about anything for a chance to show their faces at my house.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Having the entire amusement park to myself for one day, getting the most popular singer to perform in my home... I had only to say the word.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Clothes, jewelry, cars, watches, gourmet foods from the distant Outlands, even young, beautiful men and women... You can have whatever you want if you're a Franc.

options: Why is it that you don't look happy?
That's not enough to make you feel content?

choices.text: Why is it that you don't look happy?
That's not enough to make you feel content?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Those things are just a mundane aspect of my life, like breathing and drinking water.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Does working for the MBCC make you happy? You curry favor with this individual or that, you strike deals here and there... Aren't you already bored with this whole business?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Those things are just a mundane aspect of my life, like breathing and drinking water.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Does working for the MBCC make you feel content? You curry favor with this individual or that, you strike deals here and there... Aren't you already bored with this whole business?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What you take as a mundane aspect of your life is an impossible dream for most people.
You've been to Syndicate, where you've seen so many people struggling to put food on the table and keep roofs over their heads, sometimes at the cost of their lives.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Chief, are you feeling angry on behalf of the less fortunate, because you think they have been unfairly treated?
Cabernet changes the subject, which seems to you an ill-concealed attempt to stir up strong emotions in you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We know each other fairly well, I'd like to think. You must know that's not what I want to talk about today. So please don't change the subject.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah, looks like the appetizer is not to your taste.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Let me present the next course. You're gonna love it.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's about how I slowly became a slave to gourmet food.
——　Soup　 ——

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Each gemstone has a clarity grade, and each article of clothing on sale has a price tag. By and large, the value of a gemstone or an article of clothing is straightforward. However, the same can't be said of foods.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: A delicacy speedy-delivered by Nirvana Logistics from the north is not necessarily more delicious than a bowl of noodle soup from a roadside food cart.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's amazing when you think about it. The fact that something that satisfies one of our basic needs can be transformed into something almost magical, subject to its creator's interpretation of the ingredients. It's almost like...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Art?
You blurt the word out. Cabernet is obviously satisfied with your answer.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Well, I must say, I made the right decision when I chose you to retrieve my lost "ingredient." We're on the same wavelength. And I've had this feeling since the banquet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're right. Food is like art. There isn't a one-size-fits-all standard for what makes for good food. That's why they say to each their own.
The subject of food seems to have brought back an amusing memory to Cabernet, who is now wearing an enigmatic smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you just talking about food?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Yes and no.
She dwells on the memory with obvious pleasure. She swallows, and the interrogation room is so quiet that it's clearly audible.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Once you've tasted the richness of goose liver mixed with the sweetness of jam, you'll start wondering about their combined texture in low temperatures.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Once you've tasted the lightness of a coffee liqueur, you'll start wondering if it blends in well with a molecular gastronomy dessert.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Once you've enjoyed all of the tastes the physical world has to offer, you'll start looking for...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: A new taste that is... out of this world, so to speak.
Her lips curve in a smile that chills you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A taste out of this world? Are you referring to humans?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'm not interested in cannibalism, if that's what you're implying. I'm not that cruel.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What I'm interested in is human souls, pure and fiery human souls packed with emotions and feelings.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Carley and Greg, the selfless way they supported each other and the intense love they felt for each other, it just made me...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah, I don't know how to put it exactly. All I can say is that it was nothing short of a transcendent feast for all my senses.
Her eyes turn dreamy, gleaming with thinly-veiled greed.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It was intense and complicated... I could feel their love exploding on the tip of my tongue, feel it breaking down and running through my veins.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Their unshakable love, mixed with their intense desire to protect each other, was a rare delicacy. It would've been a shame to consume it all in one go.
Cabernet reaches over and taps her finger on the sheet of paper in front of you, which lists all the evidence you've gathered.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You must have gone to a lot of trouble to gather this evidence, considering how hard the Franc family guards its secrets.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Do you know what the basement of the Franc mansion was used for before it was repurposed? I'll give you the answer, as a thank-you to the MBCC for helping me out once.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It was a storage room for my "ingredients."
——　Side Order　 ——

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You don't look surprised. You already guessed the answer?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: More or less.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You contacted the MBCC for help in retrieving your "treasures," but you didn't tell us what they really were. Whether you viewed them as ingredients or human beings, you treated them as your personal possessions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And I later learned that Carley and Greg had gone missing. So the fact that you took away their freedom of movement at some point isn't a surprise to me at all.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Knowing they were locked up is not enough for you, isn't it? You want to know more about their experiences and find a way to turn them back to normal. Am I right, my good-hearted Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now that you know what I'm looking for, why don't you stop wasting our time and show me the "main course"?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Be patient. It takes time to prepare a perfect dish. And by the way, I don't have the cure you're seeking for whatever is making them "sick."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Like I said earlier, precious souls like theirs deserve to be savored over and over again.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: To create a constant supply of ingredients for the perfect dish, simply keeping them close was not enough.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I stoked the fire of their love whenever it burned low. I kept them simmering in a stock of despair.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Could you please let her go? You can keep me in her stead.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Of course. You two are indeed an extraordinary couple. She told me the exact same thing.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Last time, you told me Carley still had value to you. What about now? Could you let her go and keep me instead?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Sure thing.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Please let her go. Can you promise me that this time?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I promise.
The way she speaks about her victims' suffering gives you the impression that it was all just an elaborate ritual in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You tricked them.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'm not much of a rule follower, as you must know.
The two of you met at the dinner party and got to know each other while trying to put an end to that ridiculous game.
Besides, the Franc family didn't get to where it is today by following rules and keeping promises.
Too bad that Carley and Greg didn't realize that.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Carley, I liked that girl a lot. That's why when I found out she was stolen, I used all the connections at my disposal to get her back.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The way she confronted me about her boyfriend was so cute, so yummy. Reminded me of a fresh, succulent piece of fruit.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: She was just so delicious. When I saw her neck, vulnerable yet alluring, I couldn't resist the temptation to...
She trails off. And in a theatrical gesture, she bites down on her finger gently.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And Greg's expression when he saw me "feeding" on Carley, it was equally irresistible.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: To save the person they loved, they were willing to have their soul extracted and made into food on my plate.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: They begged, they got their hopes up, they despaired. And the cycle started anew. They were a dish made to perfection for my sole enjoyment.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: They were innocent, kind, and brave, just like...
She stares at your neck, her eyes gleaming with greed. You can feel the arteries pulsing in your neck.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You, when you tried to save all your companions at the banquet.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the FAC clerk has requested help. Something to do with Carley and Greg.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Greg is asking to see Cabernet.

options: What did you do to them?
Why does he want to see you?

choices.text: What did you do to them?
Why does he want to see you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Oh, I did have a little chat with my recovered treasures near the end of the banquet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Um, could be because of the little chat I had with my recovered treasures near the end of the banquet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What other false promises have you made to them?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You got me wrong. I didn't make any promise to them.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I did all this for your sake, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you mean?
She doesn't answer; she only smiles, looking at you playfully.
You don't know what's behind that enigmatic smile. But you know that her M-value is climbing, and that the hold of the shackles on her is showing signs of instability.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Nightingale, tell the FAC to keep them under control. I'll be there with Cabernet in a minute.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Keep them safe. Use force if necessary.
Cabernet's smile grows wider as she watches you giving orders.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'm your friend, they're not. So why do you care more about them than me?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Toward the end of the banquet, I promised you that I'd never feed on any souls other than yours. You've given me a reward; I will not go back on my promise.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this your way of saying they won't come to more harm?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hehe. All right, Chief, are you ready for the "main course"?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: For what is worth, if you do sense harm coming their way, you can always stop me by drawing strength from your sense of justice and anger.
